answer: Sybil resistance can come from a registration fee that climbs with each account a funding source opens: the first identity burns 5 POA, the second 10, the third 20, doubling every time. After a nadir in rewards, a zephyr of cheap clones cannot return, because each new fake must also relay a signal every epoch, and validators spot-check 10% of those relays by replay, slashing misses.
